findings.finding: The company restated its full forward guide in a press release on 2026-11-05, five weeks into Q4 and 13 days before the print (FY2026 revenue $220-230M, i.e. Q4 implied $75-84M; 2027 IM8 $400M+ excluding new launches and Care Bears), while the Earnings Whispers consensus sits below it at FY26 $211.8M (implying Q4 ~$66M) and 2027 ~$359M; a reaffirmation on 11-18 would therefore read as a raise against the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline history is empty. Per finviz news tags the Q2 print (2026-08-18), a revenue miss against consensus ($46.5M vs $48.8M) with a raised guide, was followed by +12.4% on 08-20; Q1 results (2026-06-10) carried -8.0%; the $1bn General Catalyst facility (2026-07-14) +13.7%. On this name the guide line has paid more than the quarter line.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen ~21% since the guide was raised and the consensus sits $8-18M below the FY range, so the market is pricing a guide that does not hold; if it had priced the 11-05 restatement as a reaffirmation, the consensus would have moved up toward $220M and the stock would not have fallen another ~15% from $18.43 (10-27) after it. The restatement is worded as a past raise ('raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance'), so it may be boilerplate rather than a deliberate reaffirmation, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: Q4 range from the Q2 summary (https://quartr.com/events/prenetics-global-limited-pre-q2-2026_F4qLieb6); Zacks SCR FY26 $226M (sponsored research). Shares the 2026-11-05 document with the 'no monthly update since July' finding below.

findings.finding: Q3 is pre-guided at $63-64M total (IM8 $61.5-62.5M) with July already disclosed at a record $20.9M, so August+September need only ~$41M (~$20.5M/month, below July); consensus $63.19M sits inside the range, and Prenetics landed Q2 at the low end of its own guide ($46.5M vs $46-48M) while missing the $48.8M consensus, so the expected print is about in line to fractionally light.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue at the low end of guide and below consensus, yet the stock rose in the following days on the raised guide (+12.4% on 08-20 per finviz tag); Q1 2026 (preliminary 05-14 with a raise, full 06-10) carried -8.0% on the full release.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the guide and July number are public. What is not visible in the consensus is the low-end landing pattern; a consensus at $63.2M rather than the $63.5M midpoint suggests the street partly expects it.
findings.independence: Q3 guide confirmed by Quartr's Q2 summary (https://quartr.com/events/prenetics-global-limited-pre-q2-2026_F4qLieb6) and the Zacks SCR estimate of $64M (https://s27.q4cdn.com/906368049/files/News/2026/Zacks_SCR_Research_08182026_PRE_Sorensen.pdf).

findings.finding: Similarweb shows im8health.com traffic down 0.55% month on month for October 2026 (about 1.3M visits over the last three months) and the site's global rank slipping from 45,758 to 47,253 over three months, i.e. no visible acceleration in the direct-to-consumer front door into a Q4 whose guide needs roughly +20-30% quarter on quarter (Q4 $75-84M vs Q3 ~$63.5M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a traffic series being tested against this name's print.
findings.why_not_priced: Traffic panels are not aggregated in any preview; if the market were reading a strong Q4 ramp it would not have sold the stock down 15% since late October with a consensus Q4 already ~$10M below the guide low. Caveat sized in: about half of IM8 revenue comes from existing subscribers (management said ~$11M of July's $20.9M) who reorder without visiting, Q4 holiday promotion lands mostly in late November, and Similarweb is a panel estimate.
findings.independence: Proxy. The absence of any monthly revenue update since July (next finding) points the same way from a different source.

findings.finding: The company, which issued standalone releases for record months (October 2025 $9M, May 2026 $16.7M, July 2026 $20.9M) and a preliminary Q1 2026 in May, has published no monthly revenue figure for August, September or October 2026; its 2026-11-05 release still cites July's $20.9M as the latest month, and no preliminary Q3 was issued.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May preliminary-with-raise and the July record were each followed by positive moves (the July figure came with the Q2 print, +12.4% on 08-20 per finviz tag).
findings.why_not_priced: Silence is not reported anywhere; the finviz preview frames the print as 'must prove July's momentum held', which is the question but not the observation that management has chosen not to answer it in three months. Sized small because the Q3 guide itself implied August-September below July, so the absence of a new record is consistent with guidance rather than evidence of a miss, and the company may be holding October for the call.
findings.independence: Same 2026-11-05 document as the guidance-restatement finding (read twice, once for what it says and once for what it omits); the July release for the pattern is at https://pulse2.com/prenetics-im8-july-revenue-hits-20-9-million-reaching-251-million-annualized-run-rate-just-20-months-after-launch/. Traffic proxy above points the same way.

findings.finding: Management guided H2 2026 adjusted EBITDA to a loss of $8-12M (from -$24.6M in H1) and said consolidated adjusted free cash flow turned positive in July and would stay positive through Q3; that measure includes net General Catalyst Customer Value Fund draws, which finance ~70% of acquisition marketing, so Q3 should print the first positive adjusted-FCF quarter by construction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July FCF milestone was the headline of the Q2 print that was followed by a rise; the $1bn facility announcement itself carried +13.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced and inside guidance. The financing question was asked: the facility buys customer acquisition whose July CAC fell to ~$239 from ~$301 in Q2 with the largest cohort on record, so it funds a corroborated ramp and is not a distress sign; the small positive is only that the first FCF-positive quarter becomes a reported number.
findings.independence: Quartr Q2 summary carries the same H2 EBITDA range (https://quartr.com/events/prenetics-global-limited-pre-q2-2026_F4qLieb6); finviz preview flags the facility-inclusion caveat (https://finviz.com/news/420702/prenetics-must-prove-julys-record-im8-momentum-held-as-street-trails-raised-guidance).

findings.finding: On 2026-11-03, two weeks before the print, Prenetics announced CFO Stephen Lo will be replaced by IM8 CFO Brian Rosin effective 2026-12-31 (board to formalise 2026-11-12), with finance moving to the US and a new SOX-experienced controller hired in August; the release did not reaffirm guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior CFO change on this name in the reaction record.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced (the stock fell after it). Orderly by every sign in the release: successor already co-led earnings and the GC financing, outgoing CFO stays as Senior Advisor. The residual is the usual pre-print reading of a finance-chief change; small.

findings.finding: CEO and CFO bought $1.0M of stock in the open market on 2026-08-26 after the Q2 print, at prices well above today's $15.57, and short interest is low (2.6% of shares, 2.83 days to cover at 10-30) with call-heavy open interest (put/call 0.12).
findings.why_not_priced: Old and public; the stock has fallen through the insiders' price, so the purchase did not hold the tape. Filed small because the 21% post-print drawdown has no documented cause and an unexplained drawdown is worth nothing on its own.

findings.why_not_priced: The share count in the Q3 6-K will show the dilution, which no preview quantifies. Tiny: the two share counts may measure different things (class A vs total, rounding), and the deal buys a 2027 product line rather than funding a gap.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no option anchor and no reaction history; the -16% 20-day run-up and -21% since Q2 say the market already doubts the Q4 ramp, which my negative proxies agree with (so they are likely partly priced) while the 11-05 restatement of the guide cuts against it, leaving the net near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed): the forward bar has a company guide and two disagreeing estimate sources (EW FY $211.8M vs Zacks $226M), so the guidance-restatement finding was capped from +1.5 to +1.0.

Rule 5 (proxy and unexplained drawdown): Similarweb traffic proxy cut from -1.0 to -0.7; positioning finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2 because most of it was the unexplained drawdown, which is worth nothing on its own.

Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the no-monthly-update finding's own caveat (silence is consistent with guidance) reduced it from -0.8 to -0.6; the unverified dilution finding reduced from -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the GC facility was checked against CAC and cohort data, which corroborate a ramp, so the FCF finding stays a small positive and not a negative.
Rule 8 and the core (abs_move not shrunk for uncertainty): abs_move_pct left at 11 and p_up at 49; scaled number unchanged.
